guide_title: Add only what you want to use
guide_description: Add-ons connect extra features to PeliGames. Choose mods, frame generation or capture and manage everything in the Add-on Hub.
guide_tabs: In each game’s details, enabled add-ons appear under Mods, Frame generation or Capture. Optional tabs appear when an add-on is available in that category.
guide_optional: You can keep just the library and essential features. To add something later, open the Add-on Hub using the bag icon in the sidebar.
guide_components: Installing an add-on does not enable its feature in every game. Open its controls to prepare the required components and configure each game.
